blind.description: A stylized open wooden footlocker or military chest with an upright hinged lid. The exterior features banded natural wood boards with dark metal reinforcing brackets, hinges, a front clasp/lock plate, and rope side handles. Inside the storage compartment are personal military/camping items: a folded red blanket, a silver metal mess plate, a metal mug, and a brown leather combat boot. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and sit directly flat on the floor without an added pedestal.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular open container with the lid swung back along the upper edge. Inside, the interior is divided between a folded red fabric block on the upper left, a small round metal plate and cup below it, and a brown boot resting on its side on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: With the lid raised, it stands approximately one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and is about 2.5 feet wide.
